description: Scala class 'Abbreviator' that truncates or abbreviates protobuf messages by limiting string, byte array, and nested message sizes based on thresholds.

classes.name: Abbreviator
classes.description: A class that abbreviates protobuf messages by truncating strings, byte arrays, and nested messages based on specified thresholds.

methods.name: abbreviate
methods.description: Public method to abbreviate a protobuf message.

methods.name: abbreviateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively abbreviates nested messages, truncating fields exceeding size thresholds.

methods.name: truncateString
methods.description: Truncates a string to max size and appends a size indicator.

methods.name: truncateBytes
methods.description: Truncates ByteString or byte array to max size and appends a size indicator.

methods.name: byteStringSuffix
methods.description: Creates a ByteString suffix indicating truncated size.

methods.name: truncateMessage
methods.description: Truncates a nested message if max level is reached, otherwise recurses.
